description: This file defines a `ShareService` class that provides methods to share one or multiple local files via the native OS share sheet using the `share_plus` package. It includes functionality for validating file existence, normalizing paths, and securely sharing files while avoiding sensitive data leaks.

classes.name: ShareService
classes.description: A utility class providing secure methods to share files through the native OS share sheet, with validation and privacy considerations.

methods.name: shareFile
methods.description: Shares a single local file specified by the path, with optional accompanying text. Validates file existence and handles errors internally.

methods.name: shareFiles
methods.description: Shares multiple local files specified by a list of paths, filtering out invalid files, with optional message. Validates each file and gracefully avoids errors.

methods.name: _normalizePath
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes a file path, returning null if the path is null or empty.
